statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The claim includes diagnosis codes I48.91 and I48.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended period
The service was ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes
The service was ordered to guide further management
The denial reason is CO-197 for missing prior authorization
